places.name: Le Buton lookout, Le Massif de Charlevoix
places.notes: Signature lookout on a man-made mound at the summit; wide view over the St. Lawrence and the mountains. Easy 2 km loop, 45 min, from the summit (resort and trail sites). Check the gondola and mountain access run on your dates; a 2026 notice mentioned a suspension during a strike. Official: https://www.lemassif.com/en/activities-events/activity-finder/lookout-le-buton

places.notes: Mountain hike with panoramic views and fall colours. The post gives no distance or time. Resolver first matched a different Mont-Sainte-Anne in the Laurentians; coordinates set by hand to the Beaupré ski mountain summit (approximate).

places.notes: Loop over three summits (Mont du Dome, Mont Orignal, Mont Saint-Michel) with panoramic views; Saint-Michel is reportedly the quietest. Mont du Dome alone: 5.8 km, 358 m, about 3 h (first post). Roadside parking, easy to find; dogs on leash. Video dated 30 Sep 2025.

places.name: Paris
places.notes: Book the Eiffel Tower and Louvre online. Marais, Montmartre, Latin Quarter. 4-5 days.

places.name: Provence
places.notes: Peak lavender mid June to mid July. Gordes, Roussillon, Senanque Abbey. 4-5 days.

places.name: Gurudongmar Lake
places.notes: Loose line in Location.md, no details. High-altitude lake in North Sikkim; permits and altitude (about 5,400 m) to check (from memory).

places.name: Sorrento and the Amalfi Coast
places.notes: Base in Sorrento for day trips; Positano, Ravello, limoncello; boat tour along the coast. 3-4 days.

places.name: Capri
places.notes: Day trip from Sorrento or Naples; the Blue Grotto closes in waves.

places.name: Rome
places.notes: Colosseum, Vatican (advance booking), Trevi. 4-5 days.

places.name: Lake Como
places.notes: Stay in Bellagio or Varenna; the ferry between towns is scenic. 2-3 days.

places.name: Milan
places.notes: Duomo, Last Supper (book months ahead), fashion district. Day trip from Lake Como.

places.name: Dolomites
places.notes: Tre Cime di Lavaredo is the icon. Planned as dolomites-july-2027 (13-26 Jul 2027). Hotel idea: Chalet Alfoss https://www.hotelchaletalfoss.it/en/

places.name: Trento
places.notes: Gateway to the Dolomites; wine region, historic centre. 1-2 days.

places.name: Florence
places.notes: Uffizi, Duomo, David (book Uffizi and Accademia ahead); day trip to the Tuscan countryside. 3-4 days.

places.name: Venice
places.notes: Stay on the main island, not Mestre; early morning walks. 2-3 days.

places.name: Verona
places.notes: Roman arena, Juliet balcony, wine region. Combine with Venice. 1-2 days.

places.name: Kennecott River rafting (Wrangell-St. Elias)
places.notes: Dream trip. World-class rafting, pristine wilderness. Requires planning well in advance; consider a guided expedition. 7+ days.

places.name: Page
places.notes: Stop 1 of the AZ-UT-CO-WY road trip post. Base for Antelope Canyon and Horseshoe Bend.

places.name: Havasupai (Havasu Falls)

stats.miles_round_trip: 35+ (Hualapai Hilltop to the Confluence, per the post)

places.notes: Red rock canyon walls, lush waterfalls and clear pools at the bottom of the Grand Canyon. From memory (unverified): permits required, sell out fast, open months ahead; the hike in to the village and campground is long, so check what is realistic with a 10-year-old. Check the official Havasupai Tribe site. Fits the Utah and Arizona parks ideas.

places.name: Monument Valley

places.name: Durango

places.name: Manitou Incline
places.notes: Steep stair climb on an old railway bed with views over Colorado Springs (figures from memory, unverified). Very strenuous, starts about 6,500 ft; check age limits for the kids. A reservation was required in recent years; check current rules and fee. Usual way down is the Barr Trail. Combine with Garden of the Gods and Pikes Peak.

places.name: Million Dollar Highway

places.notes: Gorge trail with stone steps, tunnels and many waterfalls (from memory, unverified). Gorge trail is seasonal, roughly mid May to late Oct. Check open trails and parking fee on NY State Parks. Pairs with the Vermont and New Hampshire fall trips.

places.name: Finger Lakes
places.notes: Wineries, gorges, waterfalls, scenic lakes. 3-4 days. Watkins Glen State Park is the must.

places.name: Hanoi
places.notes: Old Quarter, Train Street (check current access rules), Hoan Kiem Lake, Temple of Literature, water puppet show. Stays named in the post: Hanoi Diamond King Hotel, Queen Cafe Hotel & Pub. Post costs in INR (Delhi traveller): 1,800-3,000 a night; 5,000-8,000 for 2 days.

places.name: Sapa
places.notes: Four-day post: Day 1 town and Mong Village (Stone Church, Ban Mong alpine coaster, Rainbow Slide, Moana Cafe, night market); Day 2 Fansipan cable car and the mountain train at La Do Cafe; Day 3 Muong Hoa Valley trek, Lao Chai, Ta Van, Giang Ta Chai, homestay; Day 4 O Quy Ho Pass, Silver and Love waterfalls, Rong May glass bridge, paragliding. Also: Red Dao herbal bath, Cat Cat Village. Second post, INR costs: Sapa 11,000-18,000; Hanoi-Lao Cai by Laman Express 3,500-4,000 or regular train 1,200-1,500 (8 h); Muong Hao Eco Villa 3,000-6,000 for 2 nights; Topas Ecolodge 24,000-27,000. Rice terraces change by month; kids' limits for the glass bridge, coaster and paragliding not checked.

places.name: Ha Long Bay
places.notes: Overnight cruise among the limestone islands; kayaking and caves usually included. Post (INR): 10,000-20,000 for 2 days; cruises named Amanda Pearl 14,000-16,000, Uni Charm about 25,000 a night, La Regina Classic about 14,000, Genesis Regal and Venus 20,000-22,000; budget alternative Ha Long Lily homestay about 2,500 a night. Post text cut off after the kayaking line.
